sentences.text: The actual AI model invocation occurs when methods such as content(), chatResponse(), and responseEntity() are called.
sentences.source: Spring AI Reference 2.0.1 Chat Client API, https://docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/api/chatclient.html (verified 2026-09-08; code ticks omitted by visible text)
sentences.annotationRationale: The when constituent has an explicit subject and finite passive predicate, so it is one complete ADVERBIAL_CLAUSE.

sentences.text: The spring.ai.tool observations are recorded when performing tool calling in the context of a chat model interaction.
sentences.annotationRationale: When performing has no finite predicate; the entire temporal and contextual phrase is ADVERBIAL, including the nested in-PP.

sentences.text: The client validates the request before the model returns a response.
sentences.source: Controlled technical contrast from the Spring AI grammar review finite/non-finite ruling
sentences.annotationRationale: Before introduces a finite clause with its own subject, predicate, and object, all enclosed by ADVERBIAL_CLAUSE.

sentences.text: The client validates the request before sending it.
sentences.source: Controlled technical contrast from the Spring AI grammar review finite/non-finite ruling
sentences.annotationRationale: Before sending is a non-finite VP, so the preposition and VP form ADVERBIAL rather than ADVERBIAL_CLAUSE.

sentences.text: They measure the time spent performing the invocation and propagate the related tracing information.
sentences.annotationRationale: Two full VPs share They; and is a top-level CONJUNCTION, while spent performing the invocation modifies the object noun time.

sentences.text: The input arguments and result from the tool call are not exported by default as they can be potentially sensitive.
sentences.annotationRationale: And remains inside the coordinated SUBJECT NP; from the tool call is its ATTRIBUTE, and the final finite as-clause is ADVERBIAL_CLAUSE.

sentences.text: This configuration allows Maven to access Spring snapshot repositories directly while still using your mirror for other dependencies.

sentences.text: Structured output bridges that gap: the model is steered to produce text conforming to a schema, and the application parses it back into a typed object the rest of the codebase can treat like any other domain type.
sentences.annotationRationale: The colon introduces complete clause material; steered takes the infinitival COMPLEMENT to produce text, conforming to a schema is its ADVERBIAL, back into a typed object remains one directional ADVERBIAL, and the zero-relative beginning the rest of the codebase modifies object and remains one full ATTRIBUTIVE_CLAUSE.

sentences.text: Spring AI builds upon the observability features in the Spring ecosystem to provide insights into AI-related operations.
sentences.annotationRationale: Upon expresses the verb's relation and contains the nested in-PP; the purpose infinitive contains its own into-PP, yielding two unsplit ADVERBIAL constituents.
